_comment: Python half of INV-2 (tech-debt-hardening-plan R-TDH-19, DEC-026). Consumed by `make verify-zero-skips-python` through harness/shared/governance/verify_zero_skips.py --junit-events. A `unique_id_glob` waiver covers every nodeid it matches, but only when the skip reason carries the waiver's decision id; anything else is an unapproved skip. Lives beside the suite because the root .governance/ directory is deliberately dormant (DEC-005). Each glob must be scoped to the class or nodeid that actually carries the skip condition, never to a whole module (gate-truthfulness R-GT-7): a module-wide glob pre-approves skips nobody has written yet, and the decision-id half of the check is satisfied by any reason mentioning the id -- which the reusable POSIX_ONLY marker's reason already does.

waivers.reason: Live NVIDIA NIM tests skip without NVIDIA_API_KEY; the credential is never present in public CI

AF_UNIX is not available on Windows Python unless the optional Windows feature is enabled; the TCP block (test_the_socket_guard_is_actually_active) still runs on all platforms. Proof runs on Linux CI where AF_UNIX is always present.

TestScanFindings uses #!/bin/sh stubs that cannot execute on Windows. The real gitleaks scan is covered on Linux CI via `make secrets-allowlist-check`; all other TestMainFailsClosed tests run on every platform.

test_gate_truthfulness_e2e.py invokes GNU Make via subprocess for every test; the whole module is skipped on systems without Make (Windows dev machines). All tests run on Linux CI. Scoped to the full module because every test uses the module-level _make() helper (R-GT-7 exception: each test is individually named).

POSIX-only: creating symlinks requires SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege on Windows (elevated or Developer Mode). The same fail-closed behaviour is covered by TestItFailsClosed::test_a_policy_without_protected_paths_raises on all platforms. Runs on Linux CI.
TestGoInstalledToolsAreFoundWhereGoPutThem drives the real Makefile with a fake `go` via subprocess. Skipped on systems without GNU Make. All tests run on Linux CI.
test_the_makefile_reads_the_pin_rather_than_restating_it invokes make --eval to evaluate PIP_AUDIT_VERSION. Skipped on systems without GNU Make. Runs on Linux CI.
